items.prompt: Prove root replacement and show tie/output handling.
items.modelAnswer: Use (count,-value), with larger quality better. The heap holds the best min(k,keys_seen) candidates; its root is worst and is replaced only by a superior candidate. A final reverse sort and negation of stored IDs recover the exact order. Compare with sorting all distinct keys by (-count,value), not raw largest values or encounter-order ties.
